import socket,time,sys
SOCK='/tmp/alpine-serial.sock'
class S:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); self.s.settimeout(0.5); self.s.connect(SOCK); self.buf=b''
    def rd(self,timeout=1.0):
        end=time.time()+timeout
        while time.time()<end:
            try:
                b=self.s.recv(65536)
                if not b: break
                self.buf+=b
                try: sys.stdout.buffer.write(b); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
                except: pass
            except socket.timeout: pass
    def wait(self,needle,timeout=300):
        if isinstance(needle,str): needle=needle.encode()
        end=time.time()+timeout
        while time.time()<end:
            if needle in self.buf: return True
            try:
                b=self.s.recv(65536)
                if not b: break
                self.buf+=b
                try: sys.stdout.buffer.write(b); sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
                except: pass
            except socket.timeout: pass
        return False
    def send(self,x):
        if isinstance(x,str): x=x.encode()
        self.s.sendall(x)
    def cmd(self,c,marker,timeout=300):
        self.buf=b''
        self.send(c+'\n')
        ok=self.wait(marker,timeout)
        print('\n[CMD %r marker=%r ok=%s]'%(c,marker,ok))
        return ok
t=S()
print('connected')
if not t.wait('login:',10):
    t.send('\n'); t.wait('login:',10)
t.buf=b''
t.send('root\n')

t.cmd('cat /etc/apk/repositories; ls /media 2>/dev/null; mount | grep -E "cdrom|sr0"','__END__',30)

t.cmd('ifconfig eth0 up 2>&1; udhcpc -i eth0 -f -q 2>&1; ifconfig eth0 2>&1','__END__',120)
t.cmd('ip route 2>&1 || route -n 2>&1 || true; cat /etc/resolv.conf','__END__',30)
